'''Basram''' was a soldier in [[Lan]]'s army during the [[Aiel War]]. 

==Appearance==
He is short and stocky and has copper skin.

==History==
He is a veteran of many wars. 

==Activities==
Along with [[Jaim]], Basram is caught by Lan sleeping while on guard duty.
